lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate part 11 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan, a young used-car flipper. Deadpan, dry irony; numbers said fully. «CLS» is the Mercedes CLS, say it as «Си-Эл-Эс». Line «Стоп…» — a dramatic freeze-frame comment. Last line before the cliffhanger: «А Жора тем временем…» — slow, suspicious.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: Line 1: reluctant agreement, then firm. Line 2: calm, confident, a bit smug. Line 3: ironic, mocking question.

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: loud, cocky bet at the bowling alley. Line 2: excited, selling his buddy's car; «CLS» as «Си-Эл-Эс». Line 3: grudging respect, slow. Line 4: a quiet conspiratorial WHISPER on the phone.

notary.profile: A Russian notary woman in her 50s, precise, formal, dry official tone, glasses.
notary.notes: One line: formal, reading a contract clause, then a short question.

vitalik.profile: Vitalik — a slick Russian car tuning guy in his 30s in a tracksuit and cap, overconfident salesman, calls people «пацаны».
vitalik.notes: One line: overconfident, praising his car that is actually repaired.
